test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Idenfy the correct statement(s) regarding the Industrial Air-Condioning System.

Statement 1: Three-way valves are tradionally used in constant-flow pumping systems.

Statement 2: In three-way valves, unused water is bypassed at the coil.

options.text: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are incorrect.
Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct.

solution:
The correct answer is __Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Three-way valves__ are traditionally used in constant-flow pumping systems.
 
• They allow water to flow through the coil or bypass it depending on the system's demand.
 
• In the case of low or no demand, unused water is bypassed at the coil to maintain a constant flow.
 
• This setup ensures system stability and avoids fluctuations in water flow.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Constant-flow pumping systems:**

 
 
• These systems maintain a constant flow rate regardless of the demand.
 
• They are commonly used in older HVAC systems.
 
 
 
• **Three-way valves:**
 
 
• They are designed to mix or divert water flow between two outlets.
 
• In HVAC systems, they help regulate temperature by controlling water flow through coils.
